title: $7.5 Million Per Store, Closed Every Sunday
description:
Closed every Sunday. Still, each Chick-fil-A makes 7.5 million dollars a year.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Chick-fil-A: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chick-fil-A
- Chick-fil-A press room: Myths about becoming a Chick-fil-A Operator (Jan 2024): https://www.chick-fil-a.com/press-room/2024/01/myths-about-becoming-a-chick-fil-a-operator

2024 figures from Wikipedia: $22 billion systemwide sales, 3,109 locations, $7.5 million average per location; McDonald's $53.5 billion across 13,559 U.S. locations (about $3.9 million each, our division). The $10,000 is the initial franchise fee; Chick-fil-A says the total investment is higher. Not financial advice.

#shorts #chickfila #fastfood #howtheymakemoney

cta: Chick-fil-A or McDonald's? Comment your pick.

scenes.narration: Closed every Sunday. Still, each Chick-fil-A makes 7.5 million dollars a year.
Then the flip. Chick-fil-A builds and owns the restaurants.
The operator's starting fee? Only 10,000 dollars.
But thousands apply every year. Few get picked.
